page.title: Library
page.purpose: Browse and search the collection by what music actually is — description, attribute, or similarity to another track — and make the decomposition backlog honest rather than hidden.

priorities.statement: Search works on a partially analysed library, and says what is not yet searchable rather than silently omitting it.
Similarity search is reachable from any track — 'more like this' is a primary action, not a menu item.
Generated tracks are disclosed in listings, not only during playback.

states.description: Decomposition complete for the visible set.
Decomposition in progress with a known backlog.

elements.description: Find tracks similar to this one.
States that unanalysed tracks are excluded from attribute results.

claims.statement: While indexing, the library states that unanalysed tracks are not yet searchable by attribute.
Every track row exposes a direct control to find similar tracks.
Generated tracks carry their disclosure in listings, not only in the player.
With no source folders configured the library directs the listener to add one.
